explanation_ka:
ირიბი თქმა გამოიყენება, როცა სხვის ნათქვამს გადმოვცემთ.

1. დრო ერთი საფეხურით "უკან" იწევს:
• Present Simple → Past Simple: "I like coffee" → He said he liked coffee.
• Present Continuous → Past Continuous: "I am studying" → She said she was studying.
• Past Simple → Past Perfect: "I went home" → He said he had gone home.
• Will → Would: "I will help" → She said she would help.
• Can → Could: "I can swim" → He said he could swim.

2. სიტყვები იცვლება:
• this → that, here → there
• today → that day, tomorrow → the next day
• yesterday → the day before, now → then

3. Say vs Tell:
✅ He said (that) he was tired.
✅ He told me (that) he was tired.
❌ He said me... — არასწორი!
❌ He told that... — არასწორი! (tell-ს ყოველთვის პირი სჭირდება)

examples.en: She said that she was tired.
He told me he would come tomorrow.
examples.ka: მან მითხრა, რომ მეორე დღეს მოვიდოდა.

examples.en: They said they had finished the project.
She said she couldn't find her keys.
examples.ka: მან თქვა, რომ გასაღებები ვერ იპოვა.

examples.en: He told us he was leaving the next day.
examples.ka: მან გვითხრა, რომ მეორე დღეს მიდიოდა.

common_mistakes_ka:
❌ He said me... → ✅ He told me... ან He said to me...
❌ She told that... → ✅ She said that... ან She told me that...

ქართულში ირიბ თქმაში დრო არ იცვლება, მაგრამ ინგლისურში აუცილებლად იწევს უკან:
❌ He said he is tired. → ✅ He said he was tired.

exercises.question: "I am happy." → She said she ___ happy.

Which is correct?
options: She said me she was tired.
She told me she was tired.
She told that she was tired.
exercises.answer: She told me she was tired.
